capabilities: Open and edit CSV files in Obsidian
Generate line, pie, and radar charts from CSV data
Create table reports from CSV data
Add, edit, duplicate, and delete custom chart models in settings
Split data by quarter or week and analyze categories and value ranges
extras: Full documentation is hosted externally; the README only lists features and links to it. The author invites pull requests and issue reports, and offers Discord support.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to edit CSV files or turn their data into charts and table reports inside the vault.
summary: CSV-based financial tracker that edits CSV files in the vault and renders line, pie, and radar charts plus table reports from their data.
